stories.title: School leaders in Wales to be balloted for industrial action as pay talks collapse
stories.summary: School leaders across Wales are to be balloted for industrial action after their union pulled out of talks with the Welsh Government over pay and workload. stories.title: Chester Christmas security measures: bollard closures and blue badge changes from 18 November
stories.summary: Chester’s central streets will close to vehicles from 10.30am every day from 18 November, as the city’s Christmas market opens. stories.title: Higher Kinnerton by-election: Flintshire People’s Voice candidate Josh Swash takes 566 of 620 votes cast
stories.summary: Flintshire People’s Voice candidate Josh Swash has won the Higher Kinnerton by-election with 566 votes, 545 more than his nearest rivals.
